import cyclopts
from cyclopts.types import ExistingFile

app = cyclopts.App()

@app.command
def convert(input_file: ExistingFile, output_name: str) -> None:
    """Convert an existing file to a new output file."""
    print(f"Converting {input_file} to {output_name}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app()
